p: Hurst will be worked into the offense more as he learns it, but he must catch the ball.
The rookie played one snap after a drop; Bowles said he's still learning the offense, so don't count on a role yet.
Hurst will be targeted more going forward.
Bowles cited his improved speed and routes and said the offense needs to get him the ball more, which points to a growing role as the next receiver.
We just got to start getting them the ball a little bit more.
Bowles says Hurst's confidence is fine after he missed a potential game-winning catch, so no sign of a role reduction.
Hurst will be fine; targets are dictated by coverage rather than his play.
Three late catches in his debut, but his target volume was limited after the first series.
When they threw to him he was open.
